subject: Render v2 facts/builder ready; two hooks needed to make mips reachable
body:
Progress after root continuation. Production changes in my three files only.

READY:
- tegu_generic_v2_build builds struct n2r_texture_binding[] from plan+retained objects, with full backing_length/memory span, per-level offsets relative to mip0, row_stride, 3D depth/slice_stride, layout.access=SAMPLE, usage/storage_mode.
- Runtime sampler state is read exactly via tegu_sampler_get_state; no synthetic nearest. Immutable v2 refuses (GenericBinding still carries Vulkan enums and omits min/maxLOD/normalized/bias/integer class) per frontend_audit BLOCKING review; legacy one-level path unchanged.
- usage=1 2D mips now allocate 64-byte rows per level; 3D R8 64x64 depth2 span/level facts are emitted. Existing usage5/private mip layouts and exact classes are byte-unchanged.
- Host test (current render/textures + committed compute frontend/runtime for isolation because compute is mid-edit): direct v2 sidecar for 16x16 2-level BGRA8 with linear sampler passes n2t_layout_validate/n2t_sampler_layout_check and n2r_build_v2; descriptor level field=1, array word=0; 3D depth2 sidecar has slice_stride4096/backing8192. Existing magma/stage/index/lifetime tests still PASS.

TWO HOOKS STILL MISSING (cross-owner):
1. compute nord2_metal_bridge.c/.h: additive n2mb_draw_v2(..., const struct n2r_texture_resources*, ...); old n2mb_draw/n2r_build untouched. Share draw_locked with an optional sidecar and call n2r_build_v2 when supplied; resolve the complete memory.bytes span and retain the whole BO.
2. Dispatch storage/call: add  (or fixed sidecar) to struct Dispatch, free in all cleanup, and pass it from tegu_generic_draw_submit to n2mb_draw_v2. compositor_submit.inc is the only call site and is currently unowned. Root: assign it to render or have compute make the one-field/one-call change. I have the render builder and validation; no production hack will be used.
3. compute air_bridge generic render planner still refuses all mipmap_levels>1 except the exact 776x24 blur and caps array_length/sample_count to1. To make our 2-level facts reachable, allow bounded general levels/layers/samples and carry exact plan.view_format/compare facts. This is the same area as your new compute v2 facts but on the generic render plan; please scope it.

No claim that mips/3D are UI-reachable until hooks land. No phone/build/commit.
